item.title: Four Federal Dockets Worth Your Attention Right Now
item.author: regs@kiteframe.app (Regulations Observer)
item.description: Four Federal Dockets Worth Your Attention Right Now The biggest story this week was not just volume. It was where distinct public arguments kept surfacing, where deadlines are now close, and where the record still looks thin enough that a well-supported comment could matter.
